description: Liveline is a real-time line chart control for Uno Platform, drawn with SkiaSharp on an SKCanvasElement. The sample shows one chart on a live feed: a short loading state, then a volatile random walk with a new value every 150 ms. The line, its gradient fill, the value range and the badge ease toward each new value, a live dot marks the latest value, and the chart stops drawing once the line settles. Its default style binds every colour to the Material palette's roles, so the chart follows Light, Dark and any palette with no wiring.

showcase.summary: A real-time SkiaSharp line chart that eases toward every new value and idles once it settles.
goals: A templated control drawn with SkiaSharp on SKCanvasElement, configured through dependency properties
A default style that binds every colour to a theme palette role, so the chart follows Light, Dark and any palette
Frame-driven animation on CompositionTarget.Rendering that detaches once the line settles
Smooth interpolation of the line, the value range and the badge toward each new value
Uno.Themes tokens for corners and spacing, and utu:Responsive for the phone and desktop layouts
